PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Flatbed or drop-side? Start with how you load.

For palletized goods, steel products and general cargo, first confirm each load’s dimensions, weight and securing method. An open flatbed supports planning for different loading directions; a drop-side model also requires checking its cargo-body dimensions, sideboard height and loading equipment.

This page lists three flatbed and two drop-side models under the Chuyuan brand. For example, EHJ9400LB has an approved gross mass of 40000 kg and listed rated payloads of 34300, 34000 and 33750 kg. Gross mass and cargo payload are different specifications.

APPLICATION & SELECTION

Turn your application into selection criteria

Discuss the actual transport task first, then check the corresponding model and equipment.

01

General and palletized cargo

Share a cargo photo, the largest item dimensions and the planned load per trip. Compare flatbed and drop-side loading methods, and describe any weather-cover or cargo-securing requirements.

02

Sideboards and cargo-body dimensions

EHJ9400LB lists cargo-body heights of 600, 550 and 500 mm; EHJ9400LBE lists 600 and 550 mm. Check each model separately, rather than treating one model’s options as standard for the whole series.

03

If you carry containers

Provide the container type, dimensions, loaded weight and locking-position requirements. Appearance alone does not establish compatibility; also compare the container-chassis series.

Comparing container transport? Explore the container-chassis series.

PREPARE YOUR ENQUIRY

Prepare these four details for your enquiry

Specific information helps us compare models and configurations. Price, availability and the final proposal are confirmed through the enquiry.

Cargo and weight

Cargo description, photos, largest item dimensions, planned payload and any mixed loads.

Loading and containment

Forklift or crane loading, loading direction, sideboard height, cover and securing requirements.

Tractor and route

Tractor model, coupling information, road conditions, operating region and destination.

Model and equipment

Preferred model, tire and suspension requirements, color, quantity and intended in-service date.

You can start with the cargo and operating task; sales will help identify a model and configuration. If a model is already chosen, provide its complete code rather than only the category.
